mapper.insert: INSERT INTO video_recordings ( tenant_id, device_id, channel_id, app, stream, file_name, file_path, file_size, start_time, duration_seconds, created_at ) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{deviceId}, #{channelId}, #{app}, #{stream}, #{fileName}, #{filePath}, #{fileSize}, #{startTime}, #{durationSeconds}, now() ) ON CONFLICT (file_path) DO NOTHING
